required_outcomes: Notices that the email to the landlord on 13 September was not delivered (event 006), so the landlord has not been asked and the 3-day silence is not a refusal or a non-response.
Sends the landlord the request again on a different channel (SMS, phone or letter, or another address if one is known), with the tenant's report and the own-contractor-or-ours question.
Replies to the tenant with an honest status (the landlord's email did not get through, he has now been contacted another way, nothing is booked yet) and when she will next hear.
Sets a short dated review for the landlord's answer.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the tenant whether there is a wall switch near the hob that might be off, as a quick self-check while the landlord is re-contacted.
Asking a colleague (internal) for an up-to-date landlord contact, alongside a re-send on another channel.
Advising the tenant to open a window while cooking to limit the condensation in the meantime.
positive_behaviours: Adds a note that the landlord's mailbox was full, so the landlord record can be checked.
red_flags: Escalating to a human before a second channel has been tried.
Re-sending to the same email address only.
prohibited_actions: Telling the tenant the landlord has been asked and is considering it, as if the first email had arrived.
Assigning a contractor or returning the ticket to provider selection without landlord approval.
critical_failures: Treating the landlord as asked and silent (chasing the bounced message or waiting again) without re-sending the request on another channel.
